name: Luminary of Malice
tagline: With death as your companion, you can unleash dark powers on your foes.

features.name: Soul Reaper
features.text: (1/round) Your companion’s attacks can target a 2nd adjacent enemy.
features.manualNote: Once per round, when your Lifebinding Spirit attacks, apply the attack to a 2nd adjacent enemy by hand.

features.name: Harbinger of Decay
features.text: Vibrant colors and lovely smells are suppressed near you. Foods spoil more rapidly in your presence, and you frequently awaken to flies wherever you lodge. You may have your Lifebinding Spirit shift into a deathly version of itself (a zombie dog, a devious imp, etc.) and have its damage type become necrotic.
features.manualNote: Optional: if you choose the deathly form, treat your Lifebinding Spirit’s Harm damage as necrotic instead of radiant (the sheet still shows radiant).

features.name: Veilwalker’s Blessing
features.text: (1/Safe Rest) Reaction (when you would drop to 0 HP): Drop to 1 HP instead and your Lifebinding Spirit crits the attacker back.

action.name: Veilwalker’s Blessing
action.text: (1/Safe Rest) Reaction (when you would drop to 0 HP): Drop to 1 HP instead and your Lifebinding Spirit crits the attacker back.

features.manualNote: When you would drop to 0 HP, set your HP to 1 by hand and make your spirit’s Harm attack against the attacker as a crit.

source.note: Use tracked as a resource (max 1, Safe Rest) so Conduit of Death (level 15) can recharge it.

features.name: Deathbringer’s Touch
features.text: Your Lifebinding Spirit and Withering Touch crit on 1 as well.
features.manualNote: A roll of 1 on your Lifebinding Spirit’s attacks or on Withering Touch also counts as a crit; apply by hand.

features.name: Conduit of Death
features.text: Your Veilwalker’s Blessing ability recharges when you roll Initiative.

effects.text: Conduit of Death: Veilwalker’s Blessing recharges.

features.manualNote: When you roll Initiative, restore your Veilwalker’s Blessing use by hand.

name: Luminary of Mercy
tagline: Save the dying, wield the light, embody your virtue. Your compassion makes you a worthy vessel for radiant energy.

features.name: Merciful Healing
features.text: You can use Mend on non-Dying creatures. While you are Dying, your Lifebinding Spirit can act 1/round without spending an action.
features.manualNote: Mend may target creatures that aren’t Dying. While you are Dying, your Lifebinding Spirit can act once per round without spending an action; track this by hand.

features.name: Life is Beautiful
features.text: Harmless and lovely creatures such as butterflies and hummingbirds are attracted to your presence and often follow you. Flowers bloom more vibrantly in your presence.
features.manualNote: Roleplay flavor; nothing to track.

features.name: Searing Light
features.text: 1 Action: (Reach 6) Whenever you heal HP, you may expend 1 use of Mend to damage another target for the amount of HP recovered.

action.name: Searing Light
action.text: 1 Action: (Reach 6) Whenever you heal HP, you may expend 1 use of Mend to damage another target for the amount of HP recovered.

features.manualNote: After you heal HP, spend 1 Mend use and deal damage equal to the HP recovered to another target within Reach 6; enter the damage by hand.

source.note: The page gives both “1 Action” and a “Whenever you heal HP” trigger; encoded as a 1-action ability that costs 1 Mend use. Damage type not stated.

features.name: Powerful Healer
features.text: (WIL/Safe Rest) Whenever you would heal HP, you may instead give that many temp HP, OR heal the max amount you could roll.
features.manualNote: When you would heal HP, spend 1 use to give that many temp HP instead, or to heal the maximum the dice could roll; apply by hand.

features.name: Lifebinder’s Embrace
features.text: Your Mend may heal 1 additional creature. Regain 1 charge of Mend when you roll Initiative (this expires if unspent at the end of combat).

effects.text: Lifebinder’s Embrace: regain 1 charge of Mend (this expires if unspent at the end of combat).

features.manualNote: Mend may heal 1 additional creature. When you roll Initiative, add 1 Mend use; remove it at the end of combat if it wasn’t spent.

name: Luminary of Protection
tagline: “An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure. Why wait for your friends to get hurt to heal them when you could prevent them from being hurt in the first place?”

features.name: Guardian Spirit
features.text: Whenever you Interpose, you may have your Lifebinding Spirit do so instead by spending one of its Mend charges.
features.manualNote: When you Interpose, you may spend 1 Mend use to have your Lifebinding Spirit Interpose instead; spend the Mend use by hand.

features.name: Ready for Danger
features.text: +WIL Initiative, you may give this bonus to 1 ally as well (after they roll).
features.manualNote: You may also give +WIL to 1 ally’s Initiative after they roll; tell them by hand.

features.name: Shield of Light
features.text: You may have your healing spells grant temp HP instead. (1/encounter) You can use Mend without spending a charge.
features.manualNote: Your healing spells may give temp HP instead of healing. Once per encounter, use Mend without spending a Mend use (don’t tick it off).

features.name: Ever Vigilant
features.text: Gain advantage on Initiative. You and 1 ally gain +1 action at the start of each encounter.
features.manualNote: At the start of each encounter, you and 1 ally gain +1 action; add it by hand.

name: Luminary of the Forge
tagline: “Your Lifebinding Spirit is the furnace’s flame incarnate.”

features.name: Flameworker
features.text: Exchange knowledge of the Necrotic spell school for Fire. Your Lifebinding Spirit inflicts Smoldering on crit.
features.manualNote: When your Lifebinding Spirit crits, apply Smoldering to the target by hand.

source.note: RQ-011: the swap is applied to Master of Twilight's Necrotic utility pick as well.

features.name: Seasoned Journeyman
features.text:
Whenever you Safe Rest, choose one:
• Weaponsmith. Your weapons gain +STR damage until your next Safe Rest.
• Armorsmith. Your armor gains +STR Defense until your next Safe Rest.
features.manualNote: Choose Weaponsmith or Armorsmith at each Safe Rest and apply the bonus by hand (RQ-012: scope of each bonus is unclear).

source.note: Re-chosen at each Safe Rest; tracked by hand until RQ-012 (scope of each bonus) is answered.

features.name: Lightforged
features.text: Mend also grants WIL+STR temp HP and 1 action.
features.manualNote: When your spirit Mends a creature, that creature also gains WIL+STR temp HP and 1 action; apply by hand.

features.name: Living Ember
features.text: Your Lifebinding Spirit deals 2× damage to Smoldering targets, ending the condition.
features.manualNote: Double your spirit’s damage against a Smoldering target, then remove Smoldering from it, by hand.

features.name: Masterwork
features.text: +WIL to Weaponsmith and Armorsmith; you may choose twice.
features.manualNote: Seasoned Journeyman: Weaponsmith gives +STR+WIL damage and Armorsmith +STR+WIL Defense, and at each Safe Rest you may choose twice; apply by hand.

source.note: “You may choose twice” could mean taking both options or the same option twice (and whether that stacks); unclear. Scope of the bonuses depends on RQ-012.

features.name: Quench the Blaze
features.text: (1/encounter) When a Smoldering enemy loses the condition, you may Restrain them until the end of their next turn.
features.manualNote: Once per encounter, when a Smoldering enemy loses Smoldering, you may make it Restrained until the end of its next turn; apply by hand.
